Simple Chicken Tacos

  • 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 teaspoon cumin

Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Season the chicken and cook until browned, about 6 minutes per side.

Shred the chicken and serve warm in tortillas.
